_comment: What a provisioning system knows about a host BEFORE the host exists.
MAC and pool come from inventory (in production, from the DHCP relay's Option 82
circuit-id, which names the leaf port the request arrived on -- so nothing has to
look the host up at all). Pool -> tenant is a Palette decision: RFC-0021 item 13,
the ComputePool watcher, is what will own it.
'address' is a reservation, not a derivation. The tenant's SUBNET comes from the
fabric; which address inside it belongs to this host is an IPAM decision that
nothing currently owns. Carrying it here makes that gap visible instead of
hiding it behind an allocator we have not agreed on.
